checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Both hands and entire blue sheet visible on wooden table
must.why: Sheet is white, not blue; hands visible on wood table, sheet fully visible.

must.item: Hands bring one half over the other producing folded sheet
must.why: Paper is lifted and fiddled with, but no clear completed fold; sheet looks unfolded at the end.

must.item: Hands press along the crease after folding
must.why: No pressing of a crease is seen.

must.item: Hands anatomically plausible with convincing contact
must.why: Hands look natural, contact with paper plausible.

must.item: Blue paper remains a single consistent object
must.why: Paper is white; shape shifts between frames, size changes.

must.item: Eight-second widescreen, fixed overhead shot, no sound
must.why: Wide and likely silent, but the camera is a low side angle, not overhead.

faults.what: Paper is white, not blue as the must-haves require (though the user only asked for paper)
Camera is a side-angle view, not overhead
No clear fold completed; paper shape and size shift inconsistently between frames, looks like morphing
Folding action is vague; the paper is lifted and fidgeted with rather than folded

summary: A realistic-looking clip of hands handling white paper on a wooden table, but no clear fold is completed, the paper's shape drifts, and the paper is white rather than blue, shot from a side angle rather than overhead.
